page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an entry-level GPU-accelerated instance type belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features two dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with one thread per core, providing a total of two vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

From a resource density perspective, this instance represents a budget-friendly entry point for GPU workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing power without resource contention, though the lack of hyperthreading and the modest 1 Gbps network bandwidth limit its scalability for high-throughput tasks. The absence of local storage also introduces dependency on network-attached volumes, which may impact overall I/O latency.

The hardware configuration is designed for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks. Suitable workloads include small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, basic computer vision tasks, and entry-level graphics rendering where massive parallel processing or large memory footprints are not required.
